title: Public Sociology
seoDescription: Writing, media, and public talks bringing sociological research on inequality, immigration, and public health to wider audiences.
content:
Writing, media, and public engagement that bring my research on inequality, immigration, and public health to wider audiences.

## Media & Commentary

- **BioNews Health** — "Eight themes of vaccine hesitancy that could surprise people," June 2025. [Read](https://bio.news/health/eight-themes-of-vaccine-hesitancy-that-could-surprise-people/)
- **STAT News · First Opinion** — "Vaccine hesitancy is about much more than misinformation," March 14, 2025. [Read](https://www.statnews.com/2025/03/14/vaccine-hesitancy-misinformation-research-study-reasons-trust/)
- **Futuro da Saúde** — Interview on vaccine hesitancy and the social dimensions of public trust in health policy, March 25, 2025. [Read](https://futurodasaude.com.br/hesitacao-vacinal-estudo/)
- **Lerner Center for Public Health Promotion** — "What Factors Influenced COVID-19 Vaccine Hesitancy? Evidence from Social Media," Population Health Research Brief Series, No. 125, 2025. [Read](https://doi.org/10.14305/rt.lerner.2025.1)

## Newsletter

I write in Turkish on Substack about sociology, culture, and everyday life — [hzkoytak.substack.com](https://hzkoytak.substack.com)
